expectations.text: Every live rung's goals[].label names a PLACE and a concrete VERB (a walkthrough line)
expectations.evidence: R1 label 'Get Sol talking at the Undertow — evenings'; R2 'Drink with Sol at the Undertow — evenings'

expectations.text: A schedule-gated step also names its time window
expectations.evidence: '— evenings' on both rungs (the Undertow is an evening bar)

expectations.text: A meter-gated rung tells the player which repeatable raises the meter (feeder rule)
expectations.evidence: tips name the feeder: 'keep turning up, evenings; every one you sit through, his relation climbs'

expectations.text: The top rung cannot render blank (flag goal / ready_canvas / terminal)
expectations.evidence: R3 carries ready_canvas=sol_yard_trip; a terminal card closes on the flag
